No appointment confirmation may fabricate a payment or expand commercial-booking reads. criteria.venue: Sibling VenueReservation in Resource stores source/revision/intervals/quantity/status, without prices or payment. Extend the same free capacity computation to count it. Scope reads to its actual venue roles/account. This separates commercial records and avoids fake financial outcomes but adds one domain model and mixed occupancy scans.

Reuse interval/state/owner storage and common scans, but conditional required fields, price snapshots and read/access grants must exclude accidental commercial disclosure or fabricated zero payment.
